romanized_text:
ek vidyalay men varshik vijnana pradarshani ayojit ki j rahi thi. is bar chatron ko ais mdala banan tha jo kisi vastavik samasy k samadhan prastut kare.

nain aur usake mitron ne ek smart robot banane k nirnay liya. unak vichar tha ki robot bujaurg logon ki dainik gatividhiyon men sahayat kara sake. unhonne kai saptah tak dijain taiyar kiya, programing ki aur vibhinn sensar jodae.

pradarshani ke din robot ne agantukon k svagat kiya, davaiyon ki yad dilane k pradarshan kiya aur avashyakat padane para sahayat sandesh bhejane ki kshamat bhi dikhai. logon ko yaha pariyojan bahut pasand ai.

nirnayak mandal ne chatron se kai takaniki prashn puche. nain aur usaki tim ne atmavishvas ke sath sabhi prashnon ke uttar die. unhonne batay ki bhavishy men ve robot men svasthy nigarani ki suvidh bhi jodana chahate hain.

din ke ant men unaki pariyojan ko pratham puraskar mil. puraskar se adhik khushi unhen is bat ki thi ki unak vichar samaj ke lie upayogi sabit ho sakat hai.

key_events: Nain and his friends decide to build a smart robot
They believe the robot can assist elderly people in daily activities
They spend several weeks designing, programming, and adding various sensors to the robot

event_chain.narrative_link: Following the introduction of the setting and task for the students, Nain now decides to build a smart robot with his friends

key_events: Robot welcomes visitors at the exhibition
Robot demonstrates medication reminder feature
Robot shows ability to send help messages

event_chain.narrative_link: Following the planning and development process, the robot now demonstrates its functions

key_events: Nain and his team answer technical questions posed by the decision committee
They announce plans to add health monitoring features to the robot in the future
event_chain.scene_goal: Demonstrate Nain’s confidence and future development plans for the robot
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the showcase of the robot’s capabilities to the audience, Nain now answers technical questions and outlines future plans

Unaki khushi se bataya ki uske vichar samaj ke liye upayogi sabit ho sakte hain

event_chain.narrative_link: Following Nain’s confidence and future development plans for the robot, Sita now receives the first prize for her project

SPEAKER: Yeh robot aapke liye dawai ki reminder set kar sakta hai; bas aapko time batayein aur vo aapko yaad dilayega.  
SPEAKER: Agar kabhi koi emergency ho, to robot turant help message bhej sakta hai, jisse aapko turant sahayata milegi.

neutral_script.dialogue:
Nain: "Committee ke sawalon ka jawab dene ke liye, humne sensor integration aur power management ko optimize kiya hai, jisse robot ki operational efficiency 30% badh gayi hai."  
Nain: "Aane wale mahino mein, hum health monitoring modules add karne ka plan kar rahe hain, jisse robot real-time vitals track kar sake aur emergency alerts bhej sake."  
Nain: "Isse humara robot na sirf daily tasks mein madad karega, balki user ki health ko bhi proactively monitor karega, jo ki hamara long-term vision hai."
